item.title: Pike Lib Soccer captures first AHSAA win
item.description: Pike Liberal Arts soccer earns its first AHSAA win, topping Highland Home 6-1 behind freshman Tripp Royal’s five goals and a young roster guided by first-year coach Paul McTear.

item.title: Dream Come True: Pike County athlete Braylin Jackson signs with Lane College
item.description: Pike County three-sport star Braylin Jackson signs with Lane College, choosing the Tennessee program for a chance to play football and run track alongside former teammate Que Carter.

item.title: Troy Baseball upsets No. 8 Georgia in extra innings
item.description: Troy upsets No. 8 Georgia 6-5 in 12 innings, securing the program’s first Division I win over a Top 10 opponent since 2017 with a bases-loaded wild pitch providing the decisive run.

item.title: Traveling with Kids Who Get Bored Easily - Smart Planning Strategies
item.description: Traveling with kids who get bored easily is not about finding louder attractions or cramming more into the schedule.

item.title: Alabama Lt. Governor candidate John Wahl speaks to Pike County Republican Women
item.description: Lt. governor hopeful John Wahl tells Pike County GOP women he’s running to fight for Alabama’s liberties, push tax cuts and election integrity, and follow the conservatism of Trump and DeSantis.

item.title: Lockheed Martin manager speaks at Exchange Club
item.description: Lockheed Martin manufacturing leader and Troy University graduate Clark Jones addresses the Troy Exchange Club; his career spans USAF service and missile systems production.

item.title: Sorrel speaks to GOP Women
item.description: Alabama Auditor Andrew Sorrell tells Pike County GOP women he’s seeking a second term, citing government accountability, tiny property losses and even cutting his own office budget.

item.title: OBITUARY: Peggy Thames Faulk (Sept. 17, 1946-Feb. 23, 2026)
item.description: Peggy Thames Faulk, 79, of Troy, a former teacher, mother and longtime First Baptist Church member, died Feb. 23, 2026, after a long battle with cancer.

item.title: Gov. Kay Ivey signs legislation that could lead to the return of JUCO football in Alabama
item.description: Alabama Gov. Kay Ivey has signed a measure creating a study commission on reviving junior college football, with recommendations on community college programs due in November.

item.title: Charles Henderson, Pike Lib to make history in Terry Sikes Memorial Tournament
item.description: Baseball town Troy sees Pike Liberal Arts and Charles Henderson meet on the diamond for the first time at the 25th Terry Sikes Memorial Tournament at Troy University’s Riddle-Pace Field.
